cards.headline: Koundé works in the gym and is practically ruled out for the Clásico
cards.summary: Jules Koundé continued individual recovery on Friday and did not join the group on the pitch. AS reported his left ankle sprain, sustained against Betis, is slightly above grade one and he is considered almost unavailable for Sunday. Xavi Espart remains the leading option at right-back after his display against PSG.
cards.body: Javier Miguel wrote for AS that the French defender followed a physiotherapy session in the gym rather than training with the squad. With under 48 hours until kick-off at Spotify Camp Nou, the coaching staff view a late inclusion as a long shot. Koundé missed the PSG match and the timeline now points toward the Alavés fixture on 31 October after a clean week without European commitments. Eric García is already confirmed out for three to four weeks with a thigh injury and Andreas Christensen remains unavailable. Espart started and scored in Paris and has recovered from minor ankle discomfort. Cancelo and Gerard Martín give Flick alternatives on the left. The final training session is scheduled for Saturday at 11:00, after which Flick will face the media at 13:00. Barça can extend their six-point lead over Real Madrid with a win.

cards.headline: Pedri says he prepares the Clásico with the usual routine
cards.summary: Pedri told DSports he treats Sunday’s Clásico the same as any other match and keeps his normal preparation. The midfielder called Messi the best player in history and said he supports Newell’s Old Boys because of him. Joan Poquí reported the comments for Mundo Deportivo after the Media Day.
cards.body: Pedri spoke during the club’s Media Day ahead of the fixture at Spotify Camp Nou. He acknowledged the importance of the match against Real Madrid but insisted he does not alter his schedule. The Canary Islander played alongside Messi for a full season and described that year as too short. He also recalled supporting Argentina in tournaments when Spain were eliminated because of his admiration for Messi. The Clásico is the first of the 2026/27 season. Barça lead La Liga by six points after nine wins. Pedri started against PSG and is expected to feature again alongside Rodri. Flick’s side return to full training on Saturday morning. The match is scheduled for 21:00 on Sunday. Pedri’s comments appeared in Mundo Deportivo on Friday evening.

cards.headline: Gerard Martín trains with the group as Barça complete Friday session
cards.summary: Gerard Martín joined the full group on Friday after finishing the PSG match with discomfort. Jules Koundé stayed in the gym. Flick also called up Àlex Campos, Orian Goren and Ebrima Tunkara from Barça Atlètic. The penultimate session before the Clásico took place at the Ciutat Esportiva.
cards.body: Infobae and MARCA both reported Martín’s return to collective work. The defender had arrived in Paris with a knock yet started and completed the 4-2 defeat. Koundé’s absence left Espart as the main right-back option. Eric García and Andreas Christensen remain out. The four B-team players trained with the first team but are not expected to start. Saturday’s session begins at 11:00 and will be followed by Flick’s press conference at 13:00. The Clásico is at Spotify Camp Nou on Sunday at 21:00. Barça can open a nine-point gap. Real Madrid travel without Vinícius, who is banned. The voluntary attendance on Thursday by Yamal, Pedri, Fermín, Espart and others showed the squad’s focus after the rest day.

cards.headline: Club congratulates Messi on the Princess of Asturias Award for Sports
cards.summary: FC Barcelona posted a message congratulating Lionel Messi on receiving the 2026 Princess of Asturias Award for Sports. The club highlighted his impact on and off the pitch and the bond formed during his career at the club. The post appeared on Friday.
cards.body: The official English account shared the congratulations alongside a photograph. Messi spent the majority of his career at Barcelona before moving to Paris Saint-Germain and later Inter Miami. Laporta also sent a personal message, according to Mundo Deportivo. The award recognises sporting excellence and solidarity. Pedri, in separate comments, called Messi the greatest player he has seen and said he wished their shared season had lasted longer. The Clásico preparation continued on Friday with the squad at the Ciutat Esportiva. Barça sit top of La Liga, six points clear of Real Madrid. The next competitive fixture is Sunday at Spotify Camp Nou. Official channels also posted a video countdown and a piece on new faces in the fixture.

cards.headline: Adeyemi says Flick is the reason he is at Barcelona
cards.summary: Karim Adeyemi told club media that Hansi Flick is the reason he joined Barcelona. The German winger spoke during a live session and also took part in a light-hearted quiz about Clásico history. Joan Poquí covered the interview for Mundo Deportivo.
cards.body: Adeyemi arrived in the summer and has featured in recent matches, including a substitute appearance against PSG. He credited Flick’s project for the move. The club posted a video in which Adeyemi and Anthony Gordon joked about kit details with Lamine Yamal. Adeyemi is expected to be part of the squad for Sunday. Barça face Real Madrid at Spotify Camp Nou with several defensive absences. Flick’s side completed the penultimate training session on Friday. The German international is one of the new faces who could appear in a Clásico for the first time. Official channels also ran a countdown post on Friday evening. The match remains scheduled for 21:00.

cards.headline: Rodri is expected to set the tempo against Real Madrid
cards.summary: Mundo Deportivo highlighted Rodri’s role after he was rested in Paris. The midfielder leads Barça in completed passes and interceptions in La Liga. He chose Barcelona over Real Madrid when he left Manchester City. Javier Gascón wrote the piece on Friday.
cards.body: Rodri started on the bench against PSG so he would be fresh for the Clásico. He entered in the 60th minute with the score at 1-1. The Spain international has 17 career appearances against Real Madrid from his time at Villarreal, Atlético and City. Deco and Flick convinced him to join Barça rather than Madrid. Barça lead the table by six points and can open a nine-point gap on Sunday. Pedri is expected alongside him. The squad trained on Friday with Martín back in the group. Koundé remained individual. Full training resumes on Saturday at 11:00. The Clásico is at Spotify Camp Nou at 21:00. Vinícius is banned for Real Madrid.

cards.headline: Fernández de Blas and Pirri represent Real Madrid in the Camp Nou box
cards.summary: Fernando Polo reported that Real Madrid vice-president Eduardo Fernández de Blas and honorary president Pirri will sit in the Spotify Camp Nou box. Florentino Pérez will not travel. The institutional tension between the clubs continues.
cards.body: Polo filed the story for Mundo Deportivo on Friday. Pérez has not attended the last Clásico at Camp Nou either. Relations have been strained since the Negreira case and the Super League episode. There will be no traditional board lunch. The match itself is confirmed for 21:00 on Sunday. Barça have arranged cover for discontinuous staff who are on strike. On the pitch, Barça can extend their lead. Real Madrid arrive without Vinícius. Flick’s side are without Olmo for around a month and are assessing Koundé’s ankle. The mosaic “Batec blaugrana” will be displayed. Training continues on Saturday morning.

cards.headline: Eight players could make their first Barça appearance in a Clásico
cards.summary: Jordi Batalla listed Rodri, Gabriel Jesus, Adeyemi, Gordon, Livakovic, Xavi Espart, Brian Fariñas and Hamza Abdelkarim as possible first-time Clásico participants for Barça. Some are expected to start. The piece appeared in Mundo Deportivo on Friday.
cards.body: Rodri has faced Real Madrid 17 times in his career but never as a Barça player. Espart scored on his full Champions League debut against PSG and is the leading right-back option. Gordon and Adeyemi arrived in the summer. Jesus has started recent matches. Livakovic is the backup goalkeeper. The three younger players from Atlètic trained with the first team on Friday but are unlikely to start. Barça lead by six points. The Clásico is at Spotify Camp Nou on Sunday at 21:00. Koundé is a major doubt. Eric García is out. Flick’s press conference is scheduled for Saturday at 13:00 after the final training session.

cards.headline: Official channels post Clásico countdown and highlight new faces
cards.summary: FC Barcelona posted “48 hours to go” and a piece titled “A Clásico with many new faces” on Friday. The English account also shared a short video. The posts ran alongside the squad’s penultimate training session.
cards.body: The countdown appeared in the afternoon. A separate article listed several players who have not yet faced Real Madrid in a Barça shirt. Official channels had already shared recovery images earlier in the week. The squad completed Friday’s work at the Ciutat Esportiva with Martín in the group and Koundé individual. Saturday training starts at 11:00 and Flick speaks at 13:00. The match is at Spotify Camp Nou on Sunday at 21:00. Barça can open a nine-point gap. Vinícius is banned. The mosaic will read “Batec blaugrana”. The posts sit next to the Messi award congratulations and the Adeyemi interview material.

cards.headline: Deco meets Koundé’s agent over an informal lunch in Barcelona
cards.summary: SPORT reported that sporting director Deco shared an informal lunch with Jonathan Kébé, Jules Koundé’s agent. The meeting took place while Kébé was in the city. Carlos Monfort wrote the note on Friday.
cards.body: The encounter was described as informal. Koundé is currently recovering from an ankle sprain and is unlikely to feature on Sunday. His contract situation has been followed by the Spanish press for several months. Deco has handled several renewals since arriving. The Clásico preparation continued with the squad on the pitch on Friday. Espart is the clear alternative at right-back. Barça sit six points clear. The next training session is on Saturday at 11:00. Flick’s press conference follows at 13:00. The match against Real Madrid is at Spotify Camp Nou at 21:00.
